description: Novaforge is a game development project managed inside Arbiter. It integrates a custom Atlas core + ECS game engine, AI-powered procedural content generation, and modular mech suit upgrade systems. Server administration is handled by the standalone SteamServerAdmin project (Projects/SteamServerAdmin) which Novaforge integrates with at runtime. Arbiter acts as the AI development platform for both — planning, generating code, iterating assets, and overseeing servers autonomously.

phases.name: Phase 0 — Repo Organisation & Setup
phases.description: Consolidate all Novaforge sub-projects under one structure, establish documentation, and wire Arbiter as the AI development environment.

tasks.title: Initialise Novaforge project inside Arbiter Projects/ folder
Create master design bible: docs/design/MASTER_DESIGN_BIBLE.md covering full system architecture, feature specs, and integration points
Scaffold Core/ECS: Atlas core + ECS systems directory with stub entry points
Scaffold Tooling Layer stubs (WPF panels: Chat, FileExplorer, ToolingLayer, StatusLog)
Scaffold Game Systems stubs (Mech, PCG, Interiors/Exteriors)
Scaffold ServerAdmin stubs (SteamServerAdmin scripts)
Scaffold AI/Automation stubs (ArbiterAI integration hooks)
Link Novaforge to Arbiter: register project profile in Arbiter workspace

phases.name: Phase 1 — Tooling Layer & AI Integration
phases.description: Build a unified WPF-based Tooling Layer and connect it to ArbiterAI for automated coding, asset iteration, PCG, and system debugging.

tasks.title: WPF Tooling Layer: MainWindow with Chat, FileExplorer, ToolingLayer, and StatusLog panels
GUI Theme System: GUITheme, GUIThemes (Dark/Day/Custom), GUIThemeManager singleton with OnThemeChanged event
Dark mode default (ChatGPT palette: #202123 bg, #2A2B2F panel, #00FFAB AI text)
Day mode (soft palette: #F5F5F5 bg, #E6E6E6 panel, #007864 AI text)
Custom theme: user-defined RGB values persisted in settings; import/export support
ArbiterAI singleton (ArbiterAIManager): workspace-aware context, 40-prompt live memory, archive older prompts to SQLite
Workspace context manager: tracks all project files, tooling state, and server state for AI context
Streaming AI responses: IAsyncEnumerable token stream; ChatPanel displays tokens in real-time
AI action generation: GenerateActionsAsync() returns clickable AIAction list (insert_prefab, add_script, tooling_update)
AI action execution: ExecuteActionAsync() safely applies actions via PrefabManager / ScriptManager
Prompt archive system: tag-based SQLite archive; RetrieveRelevantArchives() feeds context back into AI
Visual Studio integration: connect Tooling Layer to Arbiter VSIX for code generation and inline AI suggestions
Open-source model integration: Ollama / CodeGeeX for unrestricted free code assistance

phases.name: Phase 2 — Remote Web Interface
phases.description: Expose the Arbiter AI backend as a persistent local web server so Novaforge can be accessed, brainstormed, and iterated from any browser or device.

tasks.title: HTTP API server (Kestrel/FastAPI): /ai/query, /ai/stream (SSE), /ai/actions, /ai/execute, /ai/workspace, /ai/theme
Remote browser client: React/Blazor frontend connecting to /ai/stream for token-by-token streaming
Clickable AI action buttons in browser: same execution pipeline as local GUI
Theme sync: /ai/theme endpoint exposes current palette as JSON; frontend applies dynamically
Authentication / access control: token-based auth for remote users; restrict destructive actions
LAN / ngrok remote access: expose server on LAN or via secure tunnel
Resource monitoring: track GPU/CPU/memory usage; prompt throttling to prevent lockups
Crash protection: auto-restart AI service on failure; rotating log for crash diagnostics

phases.name: Phase 3 — SteamServerAdmin Integration
phases.description: Integrate Novaforge with the standalone SteamServerAdmin project (Projects/SteamServerAdmin). All server management features live there; this phase covers the connection points between the two projects.

tasks.title: Wire Novaforge server identifiers into SteamServerAdmin config (app IDs, install paths, branch names)
Expose SteamServerAdmin status events to Novaforge Tooling Layer status panel (uptime, player count, restart warnings)
ArbiterAI: feed Novaforge server logs into SteamServerAdmin AI monitoring thresholds
Novaforge-specific role/whitelist config supplied to SteamServerAdmin permission system
End-to-end integration test: Novaforge game server start/stop/update via SteamServerAdmin from Arbiter Tooling Layer

phases.name: Phase 4 — Game Systems & Procedural Generation
phases.description: Core game mechanics: modular mech suit systems with tiered upgrades and AI-assisted PCG for rooms, interiors, and exteriors.

tasks.title: Atlas core + ECS: implement foundational entity-component-system; define core entities (Mech, Room, Actor)
Mech Reactor system: tiered power output; upgrades affect available weapon/armor tiers
Mech Armor system: tiered plating with visual propagation to exterior aesthetics and conduit textures
Mech Weapons system: tiered hardpoints; visual changes to exterior weapon mounts and LCD panel overlays
Mech Cockpit interiors: tier-driven interior aesthetics — LCD panels, pipe layouts, conduit density, lighting
Piloted mech mechanic: player entry/exit; cockpit camera, HUD panels, and controls
PCG Room/Interior generation: modular dynamic asset placement; complexity scales with mech upgrade tier
PCG Exterior generation: building/base exterior aesthetics react to mech tier and installed modules
PCG ↔ Mech integration: upgrade tier drives generation complexity; PCG system auto-adjusts on tier change
AI-assisted asset iteration: ArbiterAI generates prefabs and scripts for new PCG modules via Tooling Layer

phases.name: Phase 5 — Development Agent Integration
phases.description: ArbiterAI as a full-time autonomous development agent for Novaforge: repo monitoring, PCG coherence, code-test-asset loop, and server automation.

tasks.title: Repo monitoring: ArbiterAI watches Novaforge repo for new commits and proposes or implements follow-up changes
PCG coherence checker: AI validates that generated assets remain consistent with mech upgrade tiers after each change
Automated dev loop: code generation → test → asset placement → AI feedback → iteration, wired into Tooling Layer
Server monitoring automation: AI triggers SteamServerAdmin scripts from log thresholds without manual input
Prefab/template learning: AI archives all generated assets tagged by project/feature type for cross-project reuse
Versioning / undo for AI actions: track all AI-generated changes; revert any single action safely
Conflict detection: AI detects when proposed code/asset changes collide with existing project logic and pauses for review

phases.name: Phase 6 — Integration & Testing
phases.description: Cross-system integration tests ensuring all Novaforge subsystems work together: Tooling Layer, AI, game systems, PCG, mech logic, server monitoring, and agent behaviors.

tasks.title: Tooling Layer ↔ ArbiterAI ↔ Visual Studio: integration test suite verifying chat, action generation, and execution paths
Game systems ↔ PCG ↔ Mech: validation suite verifying upgrade propagation, visual changes, and asset consistency
Server monitoring ↔ SteamServerAdmin ↔ AI: end-to-end automated behavior tests (restart triggers, permission audits)
Remote web interface ↔ AI manager: verify token streaming, theme sync, and action execution match local GUI
Continuous refinement: AI identifies inefficiencies, suggests layout/asset improvements, and refactors code dynamically

phases.name: Phase 7 — Deployment & Scaling
phases.description: Deploy Novaforge's Tooling Layer and Dev Agent across developer machines and live Steam servers. Enable full AI oversight for continuous iteration.

tasks.title: Deploy Tooling Layer and Dev Agent to all developer machines
Deploy SteamServerAdmin scripts to live servers
Enable full AI oversight: continuous project iteration and feedback loops from AI analytics
Analytics dashboard: track AI action success rates, template reuse, server uptime, and PCG iteration velocity
Multi-user collaboration: optional real-time multi-user access to remote web interface with role-gated AI actions

optional_enhancements: Unity / Unreal / Godot integration adapters for testing game systems in target engines
Open-source PCG library integration (dungeon generators, wave-function collapse)
Prefab dependency tracking and sandbox testing environment before applying to main project
Dockable / multi-tab GUI panels in Tooling Layer
Searchable chat and log history inside Tooling Layer
Per-user theme persistence (remember last-used theme across sessions)
AI load balancing for simultaneous heavy requests
Plugin system for future Novaforge-specific Arbiter modules
